targeting.fix: Only queued raid-boss actions retarget through native random re-resolution. WeakSet scope leaves explicit native damage projections untouched. Previewing old raid choices no longer advances RNG. Redirection respects Grass, Overcoat and Safety Goggles powder immunity.
targeting.legitimateChanges: Single-target hits reduce victim threat after impact. Spread moves ignore threat; native redirections and scripted retaliations retain their rules.

moves.scope: Structural coverage and execution smoke checks; behavioral rules are tested separately.
